composition_series.exact_resistivity_values: Graphical values preserved in Figure 3a; not digitized as exact numbers.
composition_series.trend: Lowest resistivity reported at 5–10% Sn; increases beyond 10%.
composition_series.interpretation: Source relates behavior to dopant activation and ionized-impurity/phonon scattering; external theory and measurements are not new specimens here.

thickness_series.trend: Resistivity decreases strongly up to about 95 nm, then more slowly; carrier density increases while mobility is relatively stable. The 95 nm prose threshold is not silently changed to the 90 nm concentration-map point.

28nm_carrier_density.reason: Hall voltage below measurement capability; not zero.

electrical_context.400C_limit: Main reports partial aggregation and shrinkage with impaired transparency at 400 °C, citing unreviewed SI Figure S7. The table retains a nominal 146 nm thickness; no shrinkage factor or final thickness is invented.
electrical_context.IR_ligand_removal: Main reports absence of obvious C–H features after sufficient annealing, citing unreviewed SI Figure S6; source interpretation, not a quantitative surface-coverage measurement.
